adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (multimodal document evidence) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, episodic or hierarchical summarization, evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
